actions.action: Calculate all six totals for stated usage
actions.mechanism: Apply structured charge rules to usage, separating base price, required additions, and explicitly selected optional extras.
actions.implementation: Add labeled storage, editor, guest, and export inputs. Recalculate every plan on one billing basis; mark unsupported usage without hiding plans.
actions.check: Test boundary quantities against independently calculated totals; verify keyboard entry and screen-reader announcement of updated results.
actions.risk: Ambiguous billing periods or rounding can distort comparisons.

actions.action: Make charge obligations explicit beside each capability
actions.mechanism: A semantic comparison table distinguishes included, required paid addition, optional extra, and unavailable using text rather than color.
actions.implementation: Keep all six plan columns. Show storage, editors, guests, exports, charge amounts, and requirement triggers with associated row and column headers.
actions.check: Give visitors two superficially similar plans; ask which costs less for specified usage and which additions are mandatory. Record errors.
actions.risk: Dense tables require careful small-screen navigation and header associations.

actions.action: Expose where the cheaper plan changes
actions.mechanism: Usage thresholds reveal cost differences that a single comparison snapshot can conceal.
actions.implementation: For two visitor-selected plans, derive the next editor, storage, guest, or export threshold changing eligibility or cost ordering; provide equivalent text summaries.
actions.check: Evaluate totals immediately below, at, and above each reported threshold; verify ordering, eligibility, and screen-reader access. State when no crossover exists.
actions.risk: Changing several usage dimensions simultaneously can make threshold summaries misleading.

actions.action: Require reconciliation before proceeding to checkout
actions.mechanism: A final itemized review prevents required additions from appearing only after purchase and keeps optional extras explicitly elective.
actions.implementation: Revalidate the selected plan against stated usage. Present required-charge reasons, unchecked optional extras, and the payable total; block unsupported configurations with explanations.
actions.check: Test purchase paths requiring add-ons: every mandatory charge must appear before payment, and declining all optional extras must preserve required capabilities.
actions.risk: Repeated confirmations can cause fatigue; show one review and flag subsequent changes.
